What if you drank milk every day?
Kids are often told to drink milk for strong bones. It's packed with calcium and protein. One glass has about three hundred milligrams of calcium.

But here's the twist. About two thirds of adults around the world have trouble digesting lactose, the natural sugar in milk, so for many people, milk means a grumbling stomach! Lactose free milk and yogurt are often much easier to digest.
